name: hypertask_webhooks
does: Read or manage a managed agent’s signed outbound webhook and test or replay deliveries.
use_when: Use to configure an agent callback or diagnose a specific failed delivery.
do_not_use_when: Do not use for generic HTTP requests or agent creation; callbacks must belong to the authenticated agent or an owned agent.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. agent_id=self means the authenticated managed agent; humans supply an owned agent id. Test and replay send real deliveries, and configure or rotate returns a signing secret once.
